March 5, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Somerset Capital Management Llp increased its stake in Infosys Limited Adr (INFY) by 15.46% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Somerset Capital Management Llp bought 246,794 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.88% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.84M shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $26.89 million, up from 1.60M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Somerset Capital Management Llp who had been investing in Infosys Limited Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $17.69. About 35,964 shares traded. Infosys Limited (NYSE:INFY) has declined 17.92% since March 5, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.62% the S&P500. 
Mastrapasqua Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Teradyne Inc (TER) by 74.58% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mastrapasqua Asset Management Inc bought 30,588 shares as the company’s stock rose 19.47% with the market. The institutional investor held 71,603 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.67 million, up from 41,015 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mastrapasqua Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Teradyne Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $8.98B market cap company. The stock increased 0.31% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $45.79. About 34,971 shares traded. Teradyne, Inc. (NYSE:TER) has risen 88.99% since March 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 72.29% the S&P500.
